full_judgment:
Md Iqbal Kabir, J: On an application under Article, 102 of the Constitution, Rule Nisi was Issued in the following terms: Let a Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the impugned memo No. Raja/Estate/ Purbachal /3088 stha dated 15-10-2020 issued by respondent No. 7 (Annexure K) for canceling the allotment of plot No. 35. Read No. 103, Sector No. 5, allotment Code No. 2925 under the Purbachal residential Model Town project should not be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. 

 2. On 10-2-2021 this Court issued the Supplementary Rule Nisi in the following terms: "Let a supplementary Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the impugned Memo No.Rajuk/Estate and Bhumi-3/Purbachal /10/4003 stha dated 15-10-2020 issued by respondent No. 5 (Annexure S) allotting the plot No. 35, Road No. 103, Sector No. 5 allotment Code No. 2.92.5 under the Purbachal residential Model Town project. in the name of the respondent No. 9 should not be declared to have been issued without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper." 

 10. Mr Md Hamidul Islam, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that he deposited all the installments as demanded by respondent No. 2. Upon payment Authority allotted a plot No. 35. Road No. 103, Sector No. 5, allotment Code No. 2925 under the Purbachal residential Model Town project measuring 10 (ten) khata and thereby acquired a property right in the said plot and its cancellation without any prior show cause notice is illegal and against the principles of natural justice. In this respect he has drawn our attention to RAJUK represented by its Chairman and others vs. Rangs Properties Limited 12 ADC 314 as well as Ruhul Amin Khan Lipton vs RAJUK, reported in 72 DLR 111. The learned Advocate further submits that RAJUK had the authority to extend the time for payment of installment at different levels from three to seven years and thereafter consider the cancellation of allotment of plot for non-payment of installments on case to case basis, thus indicating that there is considerable discretion on the part of the RATUK authority to extend the period of payment of installments and that each case would have to be considered on its own merit and that in the instant case, the discretion of RAJUK of not extending the time for payment of instalment was exercised arbitrarily. Though, in this case, the petitioner deposited the entire money, nothing remains to pay. Further petitioner submits that since the petitioner has given all the installments he accrued right over the land and therefore RAJUK is required to be directed to give allotment and registration in favour of the petitioner. 

 23. The impugned memo dated 15-10-2020 pursuant to the decision of RAJUK taken in its general meeting of 04/20 so far relates to the cancellation of allotment of Plot No. 35, Road No. 103, Sector No. 5, allotment Code No. 2925 is hereby declared to have been done without lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
